name: sol7-component-evidence
goal: All assigned Explorer entity and shell components have complete contracts and API screenshots for every real state at desktop tablet and mobile

evidence: Reviewed 27 registered units, current source branches, Uses and Used In; all states require desktop tablet mobile API fetches. Five contract files remain assigned to Sol-8.

223 component states cover current rendering branches using the standard catalog. Collection snippets have declared parameter types. Full-width selectors use their real navbar context; original shared-control styling passes.
All 669 standard catalog state and viewport cases pass at one Playwright worker. Fonts and relevant images decode before capture; expected state and no unexpected browser errors are asserted.
